name: Le Loi
source:
She participated in a martial arts tournament where roughnecks gathered.

The shields protecting both sides of her were given to her as a gift when she received her sacred sword from the spirit of the lake. The moderate coolness emitted from the shield is said to keep shrimp fresh.
